newsitem.title: USA: Standex sees lower Q2 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Standex sees lower Q2 EPS.

text.p: Standex International Corp said Wednesday it expects earnings for the second quarter, ended December 31, to be below the year-earlier $9.2 million, or $0.65 per share.

It cited continued slowness in its European operations and softness in sales of its higher-margin seasonal product lines. Those lines include Christmas tree stands and religious items, Chief Executive Edward Trainor told Reuters.
He said the company will announce its second quarter earnings, which have not been finalized yet, on January 25.
The company said the lower earnings would come on revenues of $150.8 million, down from $154.1 million in the second quarter of 1995.
Standex, based in Salem, N.H., makes industrial products, mail order and institutional products.
